source: Pérez-Pueyo et al. 2019, Boletín Geológico y Minero 130: 375-392, Fig. 7: time-calibrated sauropod phylogeny with palaeobiogeography; rectangular, root left, tips right, a period/epoch/stage strip across the top, outlined range bars striped by continent, node dots, and clade labels with red leader lines. Image: census figure (1081x1074 px).
license: unverified: no licence statement in the text held
names_note: no matrix held; list = the printed tip names (collapsed clades in capitals as printed)
gold_note: Time-calibrated sauropod tree, 25 tips, most of them collapsed clades printed in capitals. Neosauropoda is a four-way polytomy (Jobaria, Haplocanthosaurus, Diplodocoidea, Macronaria): the four branches leave one vertical line. The drawing does not put nodes midway between their children, so nodes were read from the lines, not their positions. Random-sample case (seed 20261106). Topology transcribed from the figure and checked node by node; topology only.
